meta.name_zh: 全國性預防接種資料庫
meta.data_description_zh: 提供之資料為民國93至104年出生世代截至106年9月16日已匯入NIIS的接種資料。資料內容涵括個案ID、疫苗名稱劑次及接種日期均有值之3欄位，且個案ID需符戶政機關提供資訊。
meta.data_description_en: The data provided are vaccination records for the birth cohorts of 2004-2015 (ROC years 93-104) that had been imported into the NIIS (National Immunization Information System) as of September 16, 2017 (ROC year 106). The data cover 3 fields — case ID, vaccine name and dose number, and vaccination date — all of which have values, and the case ID must match information provided by the household registration authorities.
